fact: The national social registry coordinator at Taazour says the AOUN operation covers all 352,000 households registered in the social registry database.
Taazour says the AOUN operation targets 2,057,006 citizens registered in the social registry database nationwide, who verify eligibility on its platform.
AMI reports Taazour announced that the Nouakchott wilaya authorities will access the social registry platform to receive and process claims, during ongoing registry updating.
Decree 2025-162 names the Registre Social de Taazour as a source of the disaster-household database BDS-MAC and as the place where affected households' data get socio-economic analysis.

Decree 2024-073 of 15 May 2024 states that any poor household enrolled in the Registre Social is eligible for Tekavoul regular transfers (Art. 11) and any vulnerable household enrolled in it for shock-response transfers (Art. 13), so the Registre Social is in use to choose recipients.
The World Bank says Mauritania's social registry, updated and expanded with project support, included more than 305,000 of the poorest households as of November 2024, above its 200,000 objective.
